title: The Storm Rises Again
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped into Qingyun Gorge, the sky darkened abruptly—the leader of the Demonic Path had appeared in person, and the blood-stained jade token in Ling Yuan's hand was the final layer of disguise concealing Chen Ji's identity.

text.content: The dark purple transmission talisman burst into a swarm of fireflies in the secret chamber. Ye Qing's voice came sharp and urgent: "Chen Ji! Ling Yuan is besieged by the three great protectors of the Demonic Path in Qingyun Gorge—life and death hangs by a thread—come quickly!" Before the talisman's ashes had even touched the ground, Chen Ji's fingertips were already gripping the warm jade slip. The moonlight outside the window shone like frost, illuminating his suddenly overcast face. Su Qingyao rose abruptly, her sword-like brows furrowed: "This is definitely a trap. If you go, you're walking into a net." She paused, her voice dropping to a near whisper: "Ling Yuan... he was the former Sect Master after all. Why risk yourself for him?" Chen Ji offered no answer, merely pressing the jade slip to his brow center, sensing within it the faint life fluctuation—Ling Yuan's residual presence within the talisman, as weak as a candle guttering in the wind.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) That old dog Ling Yuan—death would be too easy for him.偏偏 he chooses now to cause me trouble... (Fingers tapping lightly on the desk, eyes flashing with keen light) However, if he truly dies here, this chess piece of mine becomes completely useless.

text.content: Chen Ji rose slowly, his movements elegant to the point of languor. He tucked the jade slip into his sleeve, turned, and walked toward the window, his gaze passing over Su Qingyao to fall upon the distant rolling mountain peaks. In the direction of Qingyun Gorge, faint traces of dark purple demonic energy rose and billowed. Su Qingyao stepped forward, blocking his path: "Chen Ji, your fake death scheme has entered its critical phase. The Crown Prince of the imperial court is searching for 'Chen Ji's old subordinates'—if you reveal yourself now—" Before she could finish, Chen Ji had already raised his hand, gently brushing away her fingers gripping the sword hilt.

dialogue.content: Are you truly going? (Voice trembling slightly, eyes a blend of suppressed fury and worry) That old wretch hasn't done enough harm to you already! Back then, he... (Biting her lip) I won't agree!

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to Su Qingyao, and for a rare moment, a hint of tenderness flickered in his eyes. He reached out and gently brushed the stray strands of hair from her temple: "Qingyao, you think I'm going to save him?" A faint smile played at the corner of his lips, carrying an ineffable implication: "That old dog Ling Yuan—only dying by my hand would be worth something. Before he personally hands over the secrets of the Tianji Record to me—no one else is allowed to touch him." Suddenly, a commotion came from outside the window. Su Qingyao's expression changed: "Someone's outside!"

The wooden door of the secret chamber was tapped upon lightly—three measured knocks, bearing the distinctive rhythm of the imperial court. Chen Ji exchanged a brief glance with Su Qingyao, the latter quietly retreating behind a screen. Chen Ji straightened his robes and opened the door with composure. Standing outside was a middle-aged scholar in blue robes, holding a white jade folding fan, his smile warm and welcoming. It was none other than the chief strategist of the Crown Prince's residence, Mr. Zhao. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes—quite the speedy arrival.

dialogue.content: (Raising a brow, a half-smile playing at his lips) Mr. Zhao pays a late-night visit—what urgent business brings you? Could it be that His Highness the Crown Prince has also learned news of the Demonic Path's siege of the Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master? (Tone languid, yet every word cuts to the bone)

text.content: The smile on Mr. Zhao's face froze for an instant, then restored itself as if nothing had happened. He clasped his hands in salute: "Young Master Chen is indeed well-informed. His Highness the Crown Prince has important matters to discuss and has sent me to invite Young Master to the residence for a conversation." He paused, lowering his voice: "Regarding the matter of 'Chen Ji's old subordinates,' His Highness has already reached a decision." Chen Ji sneered inwardly—sure enough, the Crown Prince couldn't wait any longer. He turned, his back to Mr. Zhao, his gaze briefly meeting Su Qingyao's behind the screen.

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's people arrived at just the right moment—with the crisis at Qingyun Gorge and the imperial court's power play pressing in simultaneously, Chen Ji would have to choose between exposing his identity and losing an ally.

choices.text: First stabilize the Crown Prince and buy time
choices.description: Have Mr. Zhao convey a message to the Crown Prince expressing willingness to cooperate but requiring preparation. Simultaneously send Ye Qing ahead secretly while Chen Ji follows to reinforce. The risk lies in the Crown Prince possibly growing suspicious, but this buys buffer time for the rescue.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the optimal rescue timing
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince will not suspect for the time being, and can use his forces to contain the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan dies while waiting, Chen Ji will lose a crucial chess piece in his scheme

text.content: Chen Ji turned, looking at Mr. Zhao with a half-smile: "Mr. Zhao, no need to be impatient. This matter requires my careful consideration." He paced to the desk, picked up a brush, and wrote a brief letter: "Kindly deliver this letter to His Highness the Crown Prince. Tell him... Chen Ji's old subordinates are willing to serve His Highness, but three days are needed for preparation." Mr. Zhao took the letter, a gleam flickering in his eyes: "Three days? His Highness the Crown Prince may not be able to wait that long—the battle reports from Qingyun Gorge have already arrived. The Demonic Path protectors are slaughtering Tianqing Sect disciples!" Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged: "Three days. If His Highness trusts me, then wait three days; if not..." He raised his hand, gesturing for Mr. Zhao to do as he pleased. After a long moment of deliberation, Mr. Zhao finally nodded and departed.

choices.description: Personally confront the Crown Prince and reveal that he is Chen Ji, heading to Qingyun Gorge in the capacity of 'Chen Ji's old subordinate.' This maximizes the chance of saving Ling Yuan, but the fake death scheme will be completely ruined, and all covert arrangements will be exposed to the light of day.
choices.visible_cost: Years of planning will come to nothing, and Ling Yuan will know you've been using him all along
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan will owe a great debt of gratitude after being rescued, and can display strength before the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Both the imperial court and the three great sects will reassess Chen Ji's threat level

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile carrying a hint of pride that seemed to overlook all beneath heaven: "Mr. Zhao, go back and tell the Crown Prince—the person he seeks is far yet near, right before his eyes." Mr. Zhao's pupils contracted sharply: "You are..." Chen Ji raised his hand, peeling from his face a layer of membrane as thin as a cicada's wing, revealing that clear, handsome, yet composed face—the famed waste, Chen Ji! Mr. Zhao stumbled backward two steps, voice trembling: "You're... you're not dead?!" Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back: "Dead? My life, Chen Ji's fate, is not for the King of Hell to claim. Lead the way—Qingyun Gorge, I will go personally."

choices.text: Pursue both lines simultaneously, act personally
choices.description: Have Su Qingyao receive the Crown Prince on his behalf while Chen Ji secretly takes on another identity to head to Qingyun Gorge. Stabilize the imperial court on one side while rushing to the rescue on the other. A perfect plan, but requiring a large expenditure of Heavenly Fate to maintain the disguise.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan Rescued, Prince Stabilized by Su Qingyao, Scheme Unaffected
choices.risk_hint: Low Heavenly Fate Will Affect Tianji Record's Foresight Ability, Subsequent Battle Risk Significantly Increased

text.content: Chen Ji whispered to Su Qingyao, "The matter of receiving the Prince, I'll leave it to you." Su Qingyao bit her lip: "But your identity—" Chen Ji smiled faintly, taking a pitch-black Jade Pendant from his bosom: "This is Ye Qing's Demonic Path token. By transforming into her guard, I can enter Qingyun Gorge without anyone knowing." He crushed the pendant, a wisp of demonic energy coiling around his form, transforming him into a black纱-masked Demonic Path woman. Chen Ji—or rather, the "Maid of Ye Qing" at this moment—slightly nodded to Mr. Zhao: "Please wait, sir. My young lady will arrive shortly."

Meanwhile, inside Qingyun Gorge. Demonic energy billowed like war smoke across the heavens, three figures suspended mid-air, each emanating suffocating pressure. The Demonic Path's three Great Guardians—Chi Ming, Xuan Sha, Xueluo—had surrounded a white-robed elderly man at the center. The old man's beard and hair were white, his face deathly pale, a deep chest wound visible to the bone still bleeding profusely. It was precisely the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: (Coughing blood, cold laugh) Demonic Path rodents, just the three of you think you can take this old man's life? (Gaze sweeping surroundings, tone suddenly turning icy) Has that boy Chen Ji not arrived yet? You've surrounded for so long—he must know by now!

text.content: Chi Ming Great Guardian冷笑一声："老东西，死到临头还嘴硬！什么陈机——那个废物早就死在我们的陷阱里，你还在指望他？" Ling Yuan heard this, eyes flickering with complex light. He recalled months ago when Chen Ji "died" before him, those terrifyingly calm eyes. That boy... he never does anything without certainty. Ling Yuan suddenly burst into laughter, the laughter pulling at his wound, blood staining half his robe: "Good! Good! Good! Today this old man takes a gamble—gambling that boy will come to save me!"

Xuan Sha Great Guardian frowned: "This old man probably has tricks, we must not be careless." Xueluo Great Guardian sneered: "Whatever tricks he has, just kill him!" The three struck simultaneously, three beams of demonic light weaving into a net, descending upon Ling Yuan. Ling Yuan's eyes flashed with determination, he bit through his tongue, spraying essence blood onto the jade token in his hand—that was the only token Chen Ji gave him before "dying." "Chen Ji! Today this old man gambles you're not dead yet!"

choice.prompt: When Ling Yuan's life hung by a thread, Chen Ji finally stepped into Qingyun Gorge—how would he appear before the crowd?

choices.text: Appear in True Form, Overwhelming Suppression
choices.description: Appear directly as Chen Ji, crushing the three Great Guardians with absolute strength. Strongest deterrent effect, but completely exposing strength will force all factions to reassess his threat level.
choices.visible_cost: Expose All Strength, All Factions Will Unitedly Guard Against Him
choices.visible_reward: Three Great Guardians Killed on the Spot, Ling Yuan Personally Witnesses Chen Ji's Terrifying Strength
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path Commander May Intervene Early, Situation Will Completely Spiral Out of Control

text.content: Just as the demonic net was about to descend, a sword light descended from the heavens! The sword light was like a rainbow, splitting a gap in the demonic net. Ling Yuan widened his eyes—the newcomer was carefree in blue robes, with handsome features, exactly the Chen Ji he thought long dead! The three Great Guardians all changed expression: "It's you!" Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, gaze coldly sweeping across the three: "I'll give you three a chance to live. Leave now, and I can pretend nothing happened." Chi Ming Great Guardian laughed furiously: "A废物 dares—" Before he finished, Chen Ji raised his hand,弹出一指. An invisible force pierced through Chi Ming Great Guardian's brow, his body collapsing softly.

choices.text: Strike from Shadows, Use Another's Knife to Kill
choices.description: Hide in the shadows, use the jade token in Ling Yuan's hand to channel the Tianji Record's power, luring the three Great Guardians into a preset trap. Seemingly Ling Yuan's desperate survival, but everything was under control.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Tianji Record Fragment's Energy, May Be Detected by Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Three Great Guardians Die to "Heaven's Will," Ling Yuan Will More Strongly Believe in Chen Ji's Fate
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan Discovers the Truth, He Will Know He Was Merely Chen Ji's Chess Piece

text.content: Just as the demonic net was about to fall, the jade token in Ling Yuan's hand suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light! That golden light transformed into an ethereal sword, slashing through the air, forcibly repelling the three Great Guardians' attack! Chi Ming Great Guardian was terrified: "What is this thing!" Ling Yuan stared blankly at the jade token in his hand, characters faintly appearing on its surface—"Heavenly Secrets Must Not Be Revealed." He abruptly raised his head, gaze sweeping the surroundings: "Chen Ji! You're indeed not dead! You're right here!" Chen Ji hid within the void, corner of his mouth curling into a cold smile—the old man isn't too stupid after all.

choices.memory_label: 凌渊发现陈机暗中相助

choices.text: Fight Alongside Ling Yuan, Join Forces
choices.description: Reveal himself and stand shoulder to shoulder with Ling Yuan, explaining his presence as an "old acquaintance." Battle while subtly hinting the truth to Ling Yuan—but not revealing it, maintaining the surface relationship of strategy.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan May Betray in Anger at Critical Moment, Leading to Attack from Both Front and Rear
choices.visible_reward: "Cooperation" with Ling Yuan Formally Established, Planting Foreshadowing for Future Power Struggles
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might be probing Chen Ji's true strength in battle

text.content: Sword light flashed, and Chen Ji landed beside Ling Yuan. Ling Yuan's eyes widened, his face flickering through shock, anger, finally settling into a bitter laugh: 'You brat, you're really not dead.' Chen Ji said calmly: 'The junior promised to take your life, how dare I die first?' Ling Yuan coughed, blood staining his beard: 'This old man thought you were joking... Fine, today we fight side by side, the past is water under the bridge.' The three guardians exchanged glances, Dark Evil Guardian coldly said: 'The trash and the old trash, quite the pair. Kill them both!' The two sides clashed again, Chen Ji and Ling Yuan back to back, sword qi and demonic light interweaving into a dazzling curtain of radiance.

Outside Qingyun Gorge, Ye Qing's figure darted through the forest like a ghost. She had received Chen Ji's voice transmission and was rushing to the battlefield at maximum speed. However, just as she was about to reach the gorge entrance, a sinister voice sounded behind her: 'Demonic Path Saint, Miss Ye Qing, long time no see.' Ye Qing spun around to find a black-robed figure standing on the tree branch, face hidden beneath a hood. That voice carried a hint of amusement: 'Chen Ji thinks his arrangements are flawless, but little does he know... every move he makes is under the Master's observation.'

dialogue.content: (Shouting) Who are you! How dare you spy on the Saint! (Demonic energy surges, yet is suppressed by the opponent's presence) ...Are you one of the Demonic Path Commander's people?

text.content: The black-robed figure chuckled lightly, pulling back her hood to reveal a face pale as paper—actually a young woman who appeared no older than twenty, with a strange purple mark between her brows. Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply: 'Purple Star Envoy!' The Purple Star Envoy was one of the four envoys under the Demonic Path Commander, specializing in intelligence and assassination. The Purple Star Envoy smiled faintly: 'Your Highness Saint, my Master has said—Chen Ji boy possesses the Tianji Record Fragment, this is something we must obtain. If you would cooperate... the Holy Sect's control over you can be lifted at any time.'

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) Lift control? I don't believe a single word of your Holy Sect's promises! (Secretly gathering demonic energy, prepared to flee at any moment) Chen Ji is my partner, I will not betray him!

text.content: The Purple Star Envoy sighed, her expression carrying a hint of regret: 'Your Highness Saint, do you truly think Chen Ji is some good person? He's simply using you. Once he gets what he wants, you'll be a discarded pawn.' She raised her hand, a purple light shooting toward Ye Qing: 'But no matter, the Commander has said—capture the Saint alive, bring her back for thorough questioning. As for that Chen Ji...' A cruel smile curved her lips: 'Let him and that old fool Ling Yuan perish together.'

Meanwhile, inside Qingyun Gorge. The three guardians had been driven into a desperate situation—Dark Evil Guardian had lost an arm, Blood Net Guardian was severely wounded, barely clinging to life. Ling Yuan leaned against Chen Ji, gasping heavily: 'Kid... who exactly are you? This strength...' Chen Ji didn't answer, only looking up at the horizon. There, a dark purple light was rapidly approaching—that was the Demonic Path Commander's aura. Ling Yuan sensed it too, his expression dramatically changing: 'Bad! The Demonic Path Commander came personally!'

choice.prompt: With the Demonic Path Commander about to arrive personally, Chen Ji must make his final decision—fight or retreat?

choices.text: Confront the Demonic Path Commander head-on
choices.description: With the strength Chen Ji has displayed so far, facing the Demonic Path Commander alone gives less than thirty percent chance of victory. But if he can hold out until reinforcements arrive, the situation might be reversed. The cost would be potentially exposing more trump cards, or even suffering severe injuries.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -20 (high-intensity combat consumption), possible severe injury
choices.visible_reward: Displaying strength against the Demonic Path Commander before Ling Yuan greatly increases Reputation
choices.risk_hint: If defeated, Ling Yuan might take the opportunity to turn against him

text.content: Dark purple demonic clouds churned, a figure slowly emerging from within them. It was a tall man in black robes embroidered with countless strange runes, eyes dark as the abyss. The Demonic Path Commander! Ling Yuan's legs went weak, nearly collapsing: 'This... how is this possible!' The Demonic Path Commander's gaze fell upon Chen Ji, a playful smile curling his lips: 'Chen Ji, this One has been waiting for you a long time. The Tianji Record... hand it over.' Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, expression unchanged: 'If the senior wants it, come take it yourself.'

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to foresee escape routes
choices.description: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points, activate the Tianji Record to foresee all possible developments over the next three hours, finding the optimal escape plan. Ensure Ling Yuan's safe retreat while preserving one's own trump cards.
choices.visible_reward: Successfully escape with Ling Yuan, and the Demonic Path Commander cannot ascertain Chen Ji's true strength
choices.risk_hint: The foresight results may contain unsettling visions
choices.process_label: 天机录启动，预见逃生之路

text.content: Chen Ji's brow center stirred slightly, a wisp of golden light flickering across his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment's power quietly activated, his consciousness instantly pulled into a chaotic void. Countless images flickered past like a carousel—the Demonic Path Commander's overwhelming demonic might, Ling Yuan's tragic death, Ye Qing captured by the Purple Star Envoy, the Crown Prince's fury, the Xuanwu Sect striking at the vulnerable moment... Finally, a blurry path emerged. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, a cold smile curling his lips: 'Got it.' He grabbed Ling Yuan's arm: 'Senior, trust me one more time—close your eyes, follow me!'

choices.text: Reveal the trump card: Crown Prince's reinforcements
choices.description: The previous deal with the Crown Prince finally comes into play—Chen Ji, using his identity as the Crown Prince's 'hidden force,' summons the Imperial Court elite who had been lying in ambush nearby. Confront the Demonic Path Commander head-on while announcing to the world: behind Chen Ji stands an empire.
choices.visible_cost: Completely entangled in the Imperial Court's succession struggle, losing neutral standing
choices.visible_reward: The Demonic Path Commander forced to retreat, Ling Yuan rescued, and the Tianqing Sect gains Imperial Court protection
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince might seize the opportunity to demand more, and the imperial court's forces will interfere in sect affairs.

text.content: Just as the Demonic Path commander was about to strike, a thunderous war drum echoed across the heavens! Countless rays of golden light rose from all directions, forming a massive formation that enveloped Qingyun Gorge. A general clad in golden armor stepped through the void, followed by thousands of iron-clad elite cavalry. 'By order of the Crown Prince, we escort the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect back to court!' The golden-armored general's voice rang like a great bell. 'Demonic cultivators, how dare you violate our Great Zhou's borders—today is your death!' The Demonic Path commander's expression changed drastically. Looking around—the imperial court's reinforcements numbered no fewer than a hundred thousand!

choices.memory_label: 陈机正式投靠太子阵营

text.content: Ling Yuan stared wide-eyed, unable to believe the scene before him. The imperial court's army, the Crown Prince's reinforcements—had all of this been within Chen Ji's calculations? Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, letting the wild wind billow his robes, a faint, composed smile playing at the corners of his mouth. The Demonic Path commander's gaze swept between Chen Ji and the imperial army, finally letting out a cold hmph: 'Consider yourself fortunate today.' With a wave of his sleeve, demonic clouds surged, carrying the remnants of the three protectors and vanishing into the horizon. Only then did Chen Ji turn, bowing slightly to Ling Yuan: 'Senior, you were startled.' Ling Yuan was silent for a long while, then suddenly gave a bitter laugh: 'Chen Ji... just who are you?' Chen Ji smiled, offering no answer—some truths need not be spoken aloud.

Meanwhile, in the dense forest outside Qingyun Gorge. The confrontation between Ye Qing and Ziwei Shi had reached its breaking point. Just as Ziwei Shi was about to strike, a dark golden talisman descended from the heavens, pinning itself directly before Ziwei Shi's feet! That was—the aura of the Tianji Record! Ziwei Shi's expression shifted dramatically: 'What!' From the depths of the forest, a hoarse voice drifted幽幽ly forth: 'Ziwei Shi, laying hands on my people... have you asked my permission?' Chen Ji's figure emerged from the darkness, a shattered talisman clutched in his hand, icy light flickering in his eyes: 'Ye Qing, go first. Leave this to me.'
